module.name: Install Multus CNI
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: install Multus CNI on a Kubernetes cluster. Multus is a meta-CNI that lets pods attach to multiple networks via NetworkAttachmentDefinition CRs — required for BNK TMM's data-plane interfaces. Pure k8s logic; no cloud bits. Per-cloud catalogs vendor this and chain a cloud-specific NAD-creation module after it.

optional.name: install_multus
optional.description: Apply the upstream multus-daemonset. Set false if Multus is already installed on the cluster.

optional.name: multus_manifest_url
optional.description: Explicit override for the multus-daemonset URL. Empty = build from multus_version.

optional.name: multus_crd_wait_timeout
optional.description: Timeout for the NetworkAttachmentDefinition CRD to be Established.

optional.name: multus_rollout_wait_timeout
optional.description: Timeout for the kube-multus-ds DaemonSet rollout.

key_outputs.name: multus_installed
key_outputs.description: Whether Multus was installed by this module.

key_outputs.name: multus_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once the DS has rolled out and the CRD is Established. Downstream NAD modules depend on this.
